<thought>By comparing the observed ¹H NMR (two equivalent CH₂ triplets, a methoxy singlet, and four aromatic protons as two ddd’s) with simulated spectra of the candidate isomers, the SMILES that reproduces this pattern is **COC(=O)CCc1ccncc1**. This structure corresponds to methyl 4‑(2‑oxoethyl)pyridine, which matches the molecular formula C₁₀H₁₃NO₂ and the NMR data.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)CCc1ccncc1</final_answer>
